anti_regression_invariants_delta.rule: A provider pre-step failure must never be relabeled as a failed scientific or implementation test unless the test step executed.
A retry may supersede a provider failure but must preserve the failed attempt in append-only custody.
License compatibility must be assessed at the smallest material rights unit in scope; repository license may not silently cover dependencies, datasets, weights or mixed payloads.
Unknown license permissions remain denied for payload copying, redistribution, training and commercial use until a verifiable grant is bound.
Every governed use must bind purpose, necessity, minimization, risk, rights, privacy, rollback boundary, provenance and evidence state.
Complex-network relations without source provenance, relation type, uncertainty, boundary/falsifier and next gate are invalid evidence edges.
Analogy, metaphor, co-occurrence and decorative graph proximity always have evidence_effect NONE.
Reducing operational friction must never broaden claim, authority, rights or scientific validity.
A friction metric is a routing heuristic only and must never be interpreted as truth, novelty, quality certification or causal evidence.
Friction before/after comparison requires identical scope or an explicit rebaseline event.
A closed TOKEN_VAZIO must retain predecessor identity, closing receipt and residual gap when closure is partial.
The phrase about limitless living code remains PARABLE_ASPIRATION; real hardware, mathematics, license, safety, privacy, evidence, authority and runtime limits remain binding.
